vehicle: GAC Aion V Plus — Tehran electric taxi fleet (1752 units delivered, ref [93])
parameter_provenance_policy: Every parameter is tagged: DOCUMENTED (from project feasibility report / cited public sources), LITERATURE_TYPICAL (representative C-SUV BEV value with uncertainty range, explicitly NOT a measured Aion value), DERIVED (computed from documented anchors). No fabricated 'measured' data.

documented.battery_gross_kWh_source: feasibility report line 462-463 citing [108] public technical specs
documented.dc_fast_charge_source: feasibility report line 463 citing [108]: '20 to 80 percent in less than 45 minutes'
documented.kmc_source: feasibility report [109] declared range (companion fleet vehicle, NOT modeled here)
documented.grade_source: TETDC stage 2 DEM analysis (Copernicus GLO-30, this project)

taxi_payload_kg.basis: driver 75 kg + ~1.6 avg passengers x 75 kg; taxi line operation can reach 300 kg at full load

motor_peak_power_kW.basis: Aion V Plus class front PMSM

eta_motor_peak.basis: PMSM peak efficiency; load-dependent analytic map used

summer.basis: A/C critical for Tehran summers (prompt §11); heat-pump-class average

pack_R_int_ohm.basis: 93 kWh NMC pack DC internal resistance

derived.air_density_note: p = 101325*exp(-1190/8435) = 88.0 kPa; rho = p/(287*298.15 K) = 1.03 kg/m3 (13% below sea level 1.18) — Tehran altitude reduces aerodynamic drag
derived.charge_note: 0.6 x 93 kWh / 0.75 h = 74.4 kW average during 20-80% session (consistent with documented 60-340 kW Tehran DC stations)
